name: io.github.nouchix/pqc-khepra-mcp
title: PQC-Khepra MCP — Free Post-Quantum Kernel & AI Flight Recorder
description: Post-quantum cryptographic signing & autonomous flight recorder for AI agents. 14 free tools.

environmentVariables.name: KHEPRA_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: License key for KTOS Master Kernel paid tiers. Leave empty for free community mode.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Supabase project URL for SouHimBou AI Flight Recorder cloud sync.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Supabase anon key for Flight Recorder cloud sync.

tools.name: pqc_keygen
tools.description: Generate ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) post-quantum keypairs for digital signing.

tools.name: pqc_sign
tools.description: Sign arbitrary payloads with post-quantum ML-DSA-65 digital signatures.

tools.name: pqc_verify
tools.description: Cryptographically verify ML-DSA-65 post-quantum signatures and agent identities.

tools.name: flight_record
tools.description: Tamper-evident client-side recording of agent tool calls to NDJSON hash chains.

tools.name: flight_export
tools.description: Export local flight recorder logs with DAG attestation anchors.

tools.name: agent_record
tools.description: Attest agent tool execution to local SQLite ledger with cryptographic provenance.

tools.name: dag_attestation
tools.description: Export cryptographic DAG audit trail of the active session.

tools.name: khepra_get_dag_chain
tools.description: Retrieve chain-linked DAG node history and verify hash integrity.

tools.name: enumerate_host
tools.description: Local system environment, network interfaces, and architecture discovery.

tools.name: fingerprint_device
tools.description: Generate tamper-evident device identity fingerprint hash.

tools.name: discover_assets
tools.description: Enumerate local system services, listening ports, and runtime environment.

tools.name: kasa_status
tools.description: Query autonomous agent runtime status and behavioral anomaly metrics.

tools.name: threat_lookup
tools.description: Lookup threat indicators (IOCs) against local offline threat database.

tools.name: nist_map
tools.description: Search base NIST SP 800-53 controls (Community teaser limited to 25 items).
